Toth Financial Advisory Corp Has $3.75 Million Holdings in Apple Inc. (AAPL) Posted by Donald Scott | Oct 27th, 2018
Toth Financial Advisory Corp lessened its holdings in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 1.5% in the second quarter, according to its most recent filing with the SEC. The institutional investor owned 20,245 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 314 shares during the period. Toth Financial Advisory Corp’s holdings in Apple were worth $3,748,000 as of its most recent SEC filing.
Other hedge funds have also modified their holdings of the company. Asset Management Advisors LLC lifted its stake in Apple by 8.0% during the first quarter. Asset Management Advisors LLC now owns 42,537 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $7,137,000 after buying an additional 3,165 shares in the last quarter. Marco Investment Management LLC lifted its stake in Apple by 13.7% during the first quarter. Marco Investment Management LLC now owns 161,415 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $27,082,000 after buying an additional 19,438 shares in the last quarter. Pegasus Asset Management Inc. lifted its stake in Apple by 2.1% during the first quarter. Pegasus Asset Management Inc. now owns 25,514 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $4,281,000 after buying an additional 528 shares in the last quarter. FormulaFolio Investments LLC lifted its stake in Apple by 3.4% during the first quarter. FormulaFolio Investments LLC now owns 26,041 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $4,369,000 after buying an additional 867 shares in the last quarter. Finally, Wedbush Securities Inc. lifted its stake in Apple by 3.9% during the first quarter. Wedbush Securities Inc. now owns 164,675 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $27,629,000 after buying an additional 6,168 shares in the last quarter. Institutional investors and hedge funds own 58.51% of the company’s stock. Get Apple alerts:
A number of research firms have commented on AAPL. Loop Capital upped their price objective on shares of Apple from $195.00 to $210.00 and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research note on Friday, July 6th. BidaskClub lowered shares of Apple from a “strong-buy” rating to a “buy” rating in a research note on Wednesday, September 12th. Morgan Stanley reaffirmed a “buy” rating and set a $247.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research note on Wednesday, September 26th. JPMorgan Chase & Co. reaffirmed a “buy” rating and set a $272.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research note on Wednesday, October 10th. Finally, Royal Bank of Canada reaffirmed a “buy” rating and set a $240.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research note on Tuesday, September 11th. Three investment analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, eighteen have given a hold rating and thirty-one have assigned a buy rating to the company. The stock currently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and an average price target of $224.63.
NASDAQ:AAPL opened at $216.30 on Friday. Apple Inc. has a 52 week low of $150.24 and a 52 week high of $233.47. The company has a market capitalization of $1,080.35 billion, a P/E ratio of 23.49, a PEG ratio of 1.68 and a beta of 1.36. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84, a quick ratio of 1.24 and a current ratio of 1.31.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings data on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 EPS for the quarter, topping analysts’ consensus estimates of $2.18 by $0.16. Apple had a return on equity of 43.50% and a net margin of 21.98%. The firm had revenue of $53.27 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $52.43 billion. During the same quarter in the prior year, the company posted $1.67 earnings per share. The firm’s revenue was up 17.3% on a year-over-year basis. On average, sell-side analysts anticipate that Apple Inc. will post 11.77 EPS for the current year.

Following the completion of the transaction, the senior vice president now owns 105,538 shares in the company, valued at approximately $24,554,471.08. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders sold 564,185 shares of company stock worth $124,444,213 in the last 90 days. 0.08% of the stock is currently owned by corporate insiders.
About Apple
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
